info.name: Mastercard Bill Payment Validator Account Opening Statuses API

items.docs: Helps determine if the present days Mastercard and ECB conversion rates are available. Refer the Support section for more information on the Mastercard and ECB rate publication schedule.

info.name: Get Status of an Existing Fraud Record for Both Mastercard and Issuer Built Transactions.

params.name: ica
params.description: Refers to the ICA of the fraud record which needs to be searched for its status. It is mandatory parameter along with Ref ID or ACN..

params.name: ref_id
params.description: Refers to the reference ID of the API call which was used to submit fraud record. This is optional parameter if ACN is present in the request.

params.name: acn
params.description: Refers to the ACN of the fraud record whose status is to be fetched. This is optional parameter for record submitted through APIs.

items.docs: This endpoint allows the initiator to get the status of an existing fraud record using combination of ICA, Ref ID & ACN, for both Mastercard and Issuer built transactions. The initiator can get status of fraud transaction submitted via any channel GFT, File upload, Online & API.
